dict.string: Open a Gmail account from multiple accounts

query="$1"
# Accounts are read from the workflow variable GMAIL_ACCOUNTS. # One account per line, format: Name | target # target can be: an email (you@gmail.com) -> mail/u/<email>/ # an index (u/0, u/1) -> mail/u/0/ # a full URL (https://...) -> used as-is
lc_query=$(printf '%s' "$query" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
json_escape() { local s="$1" s="${s//\\/\\\\}" s="${s//\"/\\\"}" s="${s//$'\t'/\\t}" s="${s//$'\n'/\\n}" printf '%s' "$s" }
items="" normalized=$(printf '%s' "$GMAIL_ACCOUNTS" | tr ',' '\n')
while IFS= read -r line; do line="$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')" [ -z "$line" ] && continue
name="${line%%|*}" target="${line#*|}" name="$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')" target="$(printf '%s' "$target" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')" [ -z "$target" ] && target="$name"
case "$target" in http*) url="$target" ;; u/*) url="https://mail.google.com/mail/${target}/" ;; */*) url="https://mail.google.com/mail/${target}/" ;; *@*) url="https://mail.google.com/mail/u/${target}/" ;; *) url="https://mail.google.com/mail/u/${target}/" ;; esac
hay=$(printf '%s' "$name $target" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') if [ -n "$lc_query" ]; then case "$hay" in *"$lc_query"*) ;; *) continue ;; esac fi
esc_name=$(json_escape "$name") esc_target=$(json_escape "$target") esc_url=$(json_escape "$url") item="{\"uid\":\"${esc_name}\",\"title\":\"${esc_name}\",\"subtitle\":\"Open ${esc_target}\",\"arg\":\"${esc_url}\",\"autocomplete\":\"${esc_name}\",\"match\":\"${esc_name} ${esc_target}\"}" if [ -z "$items" ]; then items="$item"; else items="$items,$item"; fi done <<EOF $normalized EOF
if [ -z "$items" ]; then esc_q=$(json_escape "$query") items="{\"title\":\"No matching account\",\"subtitle\":\"No account matches: ${esc_q}\",\"valid\":false}" fi
printf '{"items":[%s]}' "$items"
Type an account name to filter

Gmail Account Switcher
Usage: gmails -> list all configured accounts gmails <name> -> filter, Enter opens that Gmail in your default browser
Configure your accounts in the workflow's Configuration panel (the [x] Configure Workflow button), one per line: Name | email@domain e.g. work | me@company.com Name | u/0 (account index, order you signed in) Name | https://full/url/ (any custom URL)
One account per line: Name | email (also accepts Name | u/0 or Name | full-url)
